meta.title: Bhoomisetu — land and homes with clear checks and clear prices
meta.description: Compare every agent's price for the same land, see what was checked, and read area in gajams, guntas and acres. In Telugu, Hindi and English.

home.heroSubtitle: Compare every agent's price for the same land in one place, see exactly what was checked, and read the area in gajams, guntas or acres.
home.verifiedBody: Every badge names the check that was done: phone code, identity, owner confirmation. Nothing more is claimed.
home.compareBody: All agents' prices, brokerage and authority for the same land, side by side, ranked by a rule you can read.
home.unitsBody: Gajams, guntas, acres, cents and square feet, all at once.
home.languageBody: Search and read in the language you are most comfortable with.
home.safety: Never pay a token advance before visiting the site and checking the documents.

parcels.title: Land listings
parcels.none: No land found. Try another village or mandal name.

units.title: Area converter
units.intro: Type an area in any unit to see it in all the others. 1 gajam = 1 square yard; 1 gunta = 121 gajams; 1 acre = 40 guntas.
units.invalid: Enter a number greater than zero.
units.results: The same area in every unit
units.note: Bigha is not shown because its size differs from state to state.

compare.title: Compare offers for this land
compare.howTitle: How best value is worked out
compare.howBody: Price to you (asking price plus brokerage) counts {price}%, owner authority {authority}%, checks passed {checks}%, reply time {response}% and how recently availability was confirmed {freshness}%. A price below {outlier}% of the other offers' median is flagged, because very low prices are a common bait. Paid promotion never changes this order.
compare.noOffers: No offers for this land yet.
compare.notFound: This land could not be found.
compare.apiDown: We could not load this page right now. Please try again in a minute.
compare.invalidSort: Unknown sort order; showing best value.

footer.disclaimer: Bhoomisetu shows what was checked and when. A check is not a legal title opinion; consult a lawyer before paying.

signin.title: Sign in with your mobile number
signin.intro: We send a 6-digit code by SMS. No password needed.
signin.codeHint: Type the 6 digits we sent to {phone}. The code works for 5 minutes.
signin.privacy: Your mobile number is not shown on listings. We use it only to sign you in.

sell.title: List your land
sell.intro: Fill in what you know. If you are not sure about something, leave it empty. You can change it later.
sell.villageHint: Name of the village or colony
sell.lgdVillageCodeHint: Government village code, if you know it. It helps us find the right village.
sell.surveyNumberHint: Printed on your pahani, 1-B or sale deed, for example 123/A/1
sell.areaSource: Where does this area come from?
sell.depthHint: From the road side to the back
sell.roadWidthSource: How do you know the road width?
sell.accessRight: How do you reach the land?

accessRights.through_private_land_with_right: Through someone else's land, with a written right of way
accessRights.through_private_land_no_record: Through someone else's land, nothing in writing

sell.distanceToMainRoadMHint: Leave empty if the land is on the main road
sell.afterSubmit: Next you will add your price. Buyers see exactly which checks were done for your listing.

offer.title: Add your price
offer.existing: This land is already on Bhoomisetu. Add your price to it, so buyers can compare all offers in one place.
offer.created: Your land is saved. Now add your price.
offer.askingPriceHint: Full price for the whole land, for example 48,50,000
offer.brokeragePercentHint: Leave empty if you do not want to say. Buyers will see 2% assumed.
offer.brokerageTermsHint: For example: 1% on registration, nothing before
offer.replaceNote: If you already gave a price for this land, the new price replaces it.

mine.title: My listings
mine.intro: Keep your prices up to date. Buyers see when you last confirmed the land is available.
mine.empty: You have not listed any land yet.
mine.needsConfirmation: Please confirm this land is still available. Old offers move down the list.

done.still-available: Thanks. Buyers can see the land is still available.
done.sold: Marked as sold. It no longer shows to buyers.
done.change-requested: Your correction was sent. A reviewer will check it, usually within two working days.

mine.confirmSold: Mark this land as sold? It will stop showing to buyers.
mine.confirmWithdraw: Remove your offer? Buyers will no longer see your price.

correct.title: Correct a land detail
correct.intro: Tell us what is wrong. A reviewer checks every correction before it changes the listing.
correct.proposedValueHint: Only the new value, for example 30
correct.reasonHint: For example: the panchayat widened the road last year
correct.notListed: Location and survey number cannot be changed here, because they decide which land this is. Contact support for those.
